name: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S.
summary: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. manufactures and sells clinker and cement products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers portland cement clinkers and potassium silicate cement; and aggregates and cement bypass dust. It also provides ecoBATI CEM II C/M (L-W) 42,5 N; CEM IV/B (P-W) 32.5 R Pozzolanic Cement; CEM II/B-M (L-W) 42.5 R Portland Compound Cement; CEM II/A-M (P-L) 42.5 R Portland Compound Cement; CEM I 42.5 R-SR5 sulphate resistant Portland Cement; and CEM I 42.5 R Portland Cement.
